name: NHS & respiratory
value: Flu above baseline and rising (wk 45 data)
summary: UKHSA 12 Nov: flu admissions up to 3.65 per 100,000 and above baseline; COVID-19 stable; RSV rising
state: UKHSA's weekly report of 12 Nov, covering 2–8 Nov, says influenza activity has increased and it has advised the NHS that activity is above baseline, though still low: lab positivity rose to 8.1% from 7.8% and hospital admissions to 3.65 per 100,000 from 3.00 (UKHSA). COVID-19 is stable at low levels, and RSV admissions rose to 1.30 per 100,000 from 0.89, mostly in children under 5. No widespread NHS critical incidents were found as of 16 Nov; the next report is expected on 19 Nov.
for_you: Older people, pregnant women and those with long-term conditions are most exposed as flu rises. The NHS sets out who is eligible for a free flu vaccine and when to use NHS 111 rather than A&E.

rubric.alert: High or very high flu activity nationally, or widespread critical incidents.
